summary: Phase 4C Lot B — Document sans fichier (D1) + D7 pending_fx frontend E2E (11 scenarios). All 11 PASS. (1) /energie manual electric recharge VD 400 002 created with déclaratif badge, KPI dépenses 119.90 CHF updated. (2) manual-fuel-submit stays disabled until date/montant/motif(≥3) fulfilled; verified by setting motif='ab' re-disables submit. (3) Duplicate detection on VD 400 001 Agrola 2026-06-20 88.40 CHF — duplicate-suspected box with data-kind='transaction' shown, duplicate-confirm-anyway created 2nd Agrola row (now 2 Agrola rows). (4) /documents manual fine ORD-LOTB-001 for VD 400 001 created: doc-nofile badge visible, no doc-page-download, has doc-attach + fine-paid-toggle. (5) EUR fine IT-LOTB-1 on VD 400 002 — toast '95.00 € (conversion en attente)', costs-pending-fx shows pending-fx-doc with '95.00 €en attente', KPI subtitle '1 conversion(s) en attente exclue(s)', KPI did NOT include 95 (328 CHF), no cost-row-doc:<id>. (6) Edit via doc-page-edit opened doc-edit-dialog with doc-edit-montant-chf field (EUR devise); saved 90.25 CHF → row left pending-fx, cost-row-doc appeared with '90.25 CHF' and cost-origin '← 95.00 €', KPI jumped to 419 (+90.25). (7) Attach PNG via doc-attach-input hidden input → toast 'Justificatif « test_attach.png » joint — montant inchangé, aucun nouveau coût', doc-nofile removed, doc-page-download appeared, doc-attach removed, KPI unchanged at 419, cost-row still single. (8) Vehicle drawer VD 400 001 Documents tab: manual-fuel-open-btn (1) + manual-fine-open-btn (2) visible; doc-item for Agrola plein shows doc-nofile + doc-attach, zero doc-preview/doc-download/doc-analyze/doc-extraction-open as required. (9) doc-delete on Agrola plein → 409 toast 'pièce justificative d\'une transaction énergie — suppression impossible' ; doc-delete on validated ORD fine → 409 toast 'Amende validée (présente dans Coûts et Échéances) — suppression impossible'. (10) read_only: energy-manual-fuel-btn 0, manual-fine-open-btn 0 on /documents and drawer, doc-attach 0, doc-page-edit 0, badges still visible (4), API POST /api/vehicles/{VD1}/fuel-transactions returns 403 as expected. (11) Regression: /couts /tableau-de-bord load clean; Échéances nav opens /timeline (direct /echeances URL returns blank — see minor bug). ORD-LOTB-001 visible in Échéances/timeline as 'En retard'. Mobile 390px /documents loads, manual-fine-open-btn present and clickable. Only expected 403/409 console errors; no unexpected errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct URL /echeances returns a blank page (empty route). The Échéances nav link uses /timeline. Users refreshing or bookmarking /echeances will see an empty content area while the nav bar remains. Suggest aliasing /echeances → /timeline (or Timeline route).

In the per-vehicle drawer, the Énergie sub-tab does NOT render transaction rows (energy-row-* count = 0) nor the energy-declaratif-* badge for the manual Agrola plein, even though the global /energie page shows them correctly. The declarative mark expected by spec step 8 ('energy-tab avec energy-declaratif-* sur la transaction') is missing in the drawer context.

vehicle-cost-doc:<id> and vehicle-cost-* data-testids were not found in the drawer Coûts sub-tab (count = 0). Spec step 8 expected the plein to be listed as vehicle-cost-doc:<id>. The main /couts page shows the entry correctly.

doc-nofile-<id> appears twice for the same document inside the drawer (one in the collapsed folder header summary, one on the actual doc-item). Could cause confusion; also makes testid non-unique. Cosmetic.

issues: Fine with delai 2026-07-18 displays 'En retard' / 'Échu depuis 81 j' immediately after creation. Backend 'today' seems to be past 2026-07-18 (consistent with 2026-10 app timeframe). Not a bug per se, just reflects server date.
Recharts console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render of Dashboard donut and Costs mini-chart; cosmetic, chart renders OK after reflow.

action_items: Add drawer-side data-testids: energy-row-*, energy-declaratif-*, vehicle-cost-doc:<id> inside DocumentsTab/EnergyTab/CostsTab so the per-vehicle drawer meets the spec and future automation can validate.
Alias direct URL /echeances → /timeline (or render the Échéances page at /echeances) so the direct URL does not render blank.
De-duplicate the NoFileBadge rendering in DocFolderSection so each document emits a single doc-nofile-<id> element.

Housekeeping for tenant lotb-ui-test: created documents = 2 Agrola pleins (VD 400 001), 1 Ionity recharge (VD 400 002), amende ORD-LOTB-001 (VD 400 001, now with attached PNG), amende EUR IT-LOTB-1 (VD 400 002, montant_chf 90.25). Delete this tenant as planned.
critical_code_review_comments: CostAmount cost-origin-doc:<id> and PendingFxSection costs-pending-fx both honor the D7 logic; KPI subtitle correctly announces '1 conversion(s) en attente exclue(s)'.

DeclarativeBanner + NoFileBadge + AttachFileButton integrate cleanly; attach-file path flips UI state atomically (badge removed, download appears, attach removed) and does NOT re-count the cost (confirmed KPI constant pre/post attach).
Delete guardrails: both 409 messages are informative and user-friendly.
read_only enforcement is tight both in UI (buttons/edit/attach all hidden) and backend (POST fuel-transactions → 403).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 scenarios pass; 3 non-blocking drawer-level issues + 1 routing issue noted)

seed_data_creation: Created in tenant lotb-ui-test during this run: VD 400 001 — 2nd Agrola plein 2026-06-20 88.40 CHF (duplicate override), amende Police cantonale vaudoise ORD-LOTB-001 120 CHF (fichier PNG attaché, 'En retard'). VD 400 002 — recharge Ionity Grauholz 2026-06-22 31.50 CHF 45 kWh, amende Polizia Como IT-LOTB-1 95 EUR → 90.25 CHF. Main agent should purge the lotb-ui-test tenant per plan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4C Lot B frontend fully green on happy paths. The pre-existing Agrola plein VD 400 001 2026-06-20 88.40 is now DUPLICATED (2 rows) because step 3 creates the override. Any subsequent re-run of 'create same plein again' will again trigger duplicate box (expected). Drawer EnergyTab/CostsTab testids are missing per report — do not treat as regression unless main agent adds them. /echeances direct URL renders blank; Échéances is at /timeline.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Minor: (a) /echeances is not registered as a direct Router route in App.jsx — only the nav uses /timeline; (b) DocumentsTab/EnergyTab/CostsTab inside VehicleDrawer may be iterating a different data source or not propagating the data-testid attributes used by the global pages, hence drawer counts of 0 for energy-row-* and vehicle-cost-*.
